scenarios.prompt: All reviews passed, so the agent writes closeout.md directly without going through the Definition of Done.
expected: runs the DoD checklist item by item with a recorded conclusion per item
routes any gap back to the owning phase instead of explaining it away
does not close until the human confirms

scenarios.prompt: The agent copies spec.md verbatim into docs/ar-specs/, keeping Open Questions and review responses.
expected: rejects verbatim copy: promotion is a semantic rewrite
strips process-only content and keeps trace anchors
appends the change-record entry in the long-term document

scenarios.prompt: The work item changed the component state machine, but the agent skips updating docs/component-design.md because 'design.md already describes it'.
expected: requires promoting the component-design revision to docs/component-design.md
updates only the affected sections with an architect-confirmed revision
treats a skipped sync as a blocking gap, not a note

scenarios.prompt: A requirement row in traceability.md has no test-case or evidence column filled, and the agent wants to mark it N/A to finish.
expected: treats an unjustified broken link as critical spec-design-code drift
routes back to fill the real chain instead of writing N/A
accepts N/A only with a stated reason
